note: Ligature carries a clear grave (ϗ̀). Next glyph is a narrow two-stroke u, matching the upsilon of λυπηροῖς and unlike the three-lobed omega of ὡρισμένη; then iota with a rough breathing whose shape matches the rough over ὁ on the same line. Printed as υἱς, recorded diplomatically.
Line opens 'b36.' — the 3 is fully inked; llama's empty span is a drop.
Short x-height italic iota with bottom-right hook, next to the tall roman 1 with flag and base serif: 'ι1.' after 'θ1.' (HA book ι).
Two verticals with a descending right leg = η, not γ; Πη13/1332a40 is Politics book VII.
Italic Greek alpha (bowl with crossing tail), matching α elsewhere; not roman a.
Capital with a closed bowl on one stem = Ρ, not Π; Ρα9/1366b1 is Rhetoric I.9.
Superscript column letter is a compact x-height 'a' with no ascender; a 'b' would show a tall stem.
Single ȣ ligature (not ου) with a smooth breathing opening left, then chi with descender: ȣ̓χ, not ȣ̓κ.
Second glyph of νικαί is a thin serifed vertical (iota), not a round omicron.
